scope: Last fixed-rule diagnostic on previously observed history; not independent out-of-sample research. No parameter sweep, reverse-signal retry or winner selection.
pool: Signal-day finite frozen emotion score, mapped ETF, positive close and volume. Alias scores averaged per ETF; all three primary accounts share this pool.
schedule: First existing weekly signal in each calendar month; next A-share session open. No execution for final pending signal. Monthly frequency is the only turnover constraint; no hard turnover cap.

dedup.method: Greedy complete-link groups: sort ETF codes, seed with smallest unused code, admit remaining codes in ascending order only if correlation with every member is >= threshold. Missing correlations never create an edge. No forward-fill in return estimation. Groups are proxies, not proven independent sectors.
dedup.representative: Highest mean within-group past correlation (medoid), tie by ETF code. Singletons represent themselves. Exactly the same representative in B and C, independent of emotion.

emotion_overlay.method: Mean of frozen ETF emotion scores within each group; average ranks scaled to [-1,1]; group weight proportional to 1 + amplitude * scaled rank. Equal scores or one group imply no tilt. No IC direction switch, no threshold fitting.

accounts.B_dedup_equal: Equal-weight correlation groups, one representative per group, monthly
accounts.C_dedup_emotion: Same representatives as B with bounded emotion tilt, monthly
accounts.reference_weekly_equal: Prior same-pool weekly equal-weight account; supplementary frequency control

inference.series: Paired daily log-return difference C minus B, common first execution through final close, including initial entry costs; moving-block resampling. Descriptive interval on already observed history, not a corrected discovery p-value.
inference.stability: Non-overlapping monthly execution periods, excluding final right-censored period. Require at least 12 completed periods and >=2/3 strictly positive C-minus-B net period returns.

all_required: C net cumulative return strictly exceeds B
C net cumulative return strictly exceeds A
C net maximum drawdown is no worse than B (numerical tolerance 1e-10)
95% moving-block interval lower bound of mean daily C-minus-B net log return is strictly positive
At least 12 completed monthly execution periods and >=2/3 strictly positive C-minus-B net periods
C stress-cost cumulative return strictly exceeds B stress-cost cumulative return
exit_rule.on_any_failure: observation_only: end this trading research route; preserve scoring, market observation and historical diagnostics, remove actionable trading interpretations from current reports/dashboard. Do not change emotion parameters or retry rules.
exit_rule.on_all_pass: research_only: no live promotion; historical point-in-time constituents/mapping and future untouched evidence still required.

limitations: Current constituent and ETF mapping snapshots, not historical point-in-time reconstruction
Normalized adjusted units; no board lots, minimum commissions, capacity or limit-price queue simulation
No costless terminal liquidation; all accounts marked at final close
Correlation does not identify all common policy, sector or style risks
Rules fixed before this experiment's results, but the historical sample was already studied
